_comment: Generated by Tools/BuildFabAnimMap.py. clips.<set>_<key>: source clip; timing measured by RetargetFabAnimations.py. locomotion.<set>: idle + walk/run in 8 directions. bodies: ChampionAttacks02 folder -> set. fabBodies: Fab body mesh -> folder. styles: WeaponLoadouts preset -> set.

monsterSets._comment: monster-rig: weapon-matched Fab sets for the Tripo monster bodies (Tools/RetargetFabAnimations.py -CireFabAnimMonsterSets). assign: body variant -> set ('' = keep the Tripo library clips). roles: set -> monster role -> clip id in 'clips' or 'loco:<key>' in 'locomotion' (locomotionOf picks another set's loops).
